name: Castejón de Alarba (Spain)
description: The four red bars of Aragon on yellow, charged at the centre with a green lozenge edged blue bearing a white tower topped by a black covered cup.
history: The flag is a cloth of the Royal Sign of Aragon, formed of four red and five yellow bands placed alternately and of the same width, of proportion 2:3, with a green lozenge edged by a broad blue band at its centre, and within it a white tower with green door and windows surmounted by a black covered cup outlined in yellow.

features.role: lozenge edged with a broad blue band
tower with green door and windows on the lozenge
covered cup outlined yellow above the tower
